description: A dim workshop with brick walls and a hanging lamp. A man in a white shirt, dark tie and rolled sleeves bends over a long machine of horizontal steel shafts, brass gears and glass wheel-discs, adjusting a gear. At the right edge, a second man in shirtsleeves draws a curve with a pen on graph paper on a wooden table. The machinery and clothing look early twentieth century. No text or frame is visible; the painting runs edge to edge.
